decision: We will keep the personal line's 1:1 chats (both ways) in the seed inbox tables, reversing 015's no-chat-log stance; owner: "keep track of those conversations ... to evaluate the assistant over time".
options_considered: Intake only (cannot show the thread or agent replies) vs seed inbox tables beside intake (chosen). Owner ask via tech-lead.

decision: We will give the chat tables no browser policy or grant (tier:org, service role only); the seed DDL's org-member SELECT policy is dropped: third-party messages, admin-only routes.
We will store only 1:1 chats in the inbox (no groups, status, broadcast, excluded numbers) and keep owner sends plus agent replies; groups are third parties the assistant never touches.
We will keep the intake feed live-only (24h) and inbound-only so the classifier input contract is unchanged and a history backfill never floods it. Tech-lead confirmed the 24h window.
We will append the owner's own text (from_me, source != api) to the agent's thread as role humano, no turn, authored by the connection creator, so the agent does not contradict the owner.
options_considered: Approved by the tech-lead (reply-forward YES); agents' append route exists (anexar_mensagem), nothing new built.
